note: The transition registry: every transition / set-piece tin with the owner's verdict and the evidence. Read by tools/plan_check.py before any render. verdict: liked (praised, or kept in a standard after review), ok (shipped in an approved edit without comment), rejected (the owner disliked or removed it; don't reuse without the fix in 'fix'), banned (breaks a banned rule; never). tags: generic (filler; keep generic <= 30 %), black_occluder (bars / boxes / a dark surround: banned since v107), face_gimmick (graphics converging on a face: banned), signature (a custom graphic-into-transition; give it ~1 s), physical (a real object or phenomenon), lands_on_face (the incoming face must be centred at the landing). Add every new verdict here in the same turn as the handoff.
